openings.claim: Speculatively, replace completed adjudication counts with worst-case certificates: remaining uncertainty may not change the acceptance verdict. Group paired candidate-minus-baseline correctness intervals by slice in the confusion table: unresolved differing predictions contribute [-1,+1], agreeing predictions zero. Select an accessible flagged row whose possible adjudication most reduces uncertainty at a threatened acceptance boundary; deterministically break ties by record ID.
openings.discriminator: Rival: adjudicate the sixteen highest-disagreement rows before ordinary counts. Certificates may reach a supported verdict with fewer adjudications when disagreements concern prediction agreements or harmless margins; with decisive rows, the rival may match or outperform. Compare adjudications to supported verdict, unresolved frequency and sealed-key agreement.
openings.probe: Run both on matched copies within seventy minutes, each with an independently reset sixteen-row allowance. Preselect the same four withheld rows before either run. Use only supplied records/labels; unchanged thresholds. Log selections, reasons, results, unsuccessful accesses and elapsed time; failed access consumes no allowance. Advance only when total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2. Reject only when total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2. Otherwise continue or report unresolved at capacity. Freeze both reports before opening the full-label key.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes individual supplied records support reproducible paired correctness calculations. Influence distribution is unknown; withheld pivotal rows or more than sixteen necessary resolutions defeat early certification. Wide conservative bounds can leave an otherwise decidable case unresolved. Tests enabling feasibility, not deployment readiness or reliable improvement.

lineage.reason: Retains relation, complete rival/test, uncertainty, stopping/resource caveats and declared preserves fit; no protected item omitted.

decision: Retain for required record-level calculation and bounded comparison. Provisional +6, the -2 slice with nine flagged labels, and greatest-gain slice annotator disagreements establish neither a verdict nor early-certification possibility.
